ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 7 overnight screening runs, the highest conviction signal in today's digest. The stock trades ~40% below the 14-analyst consensus target of $247.31 despite reporting record Q2 revenue of +51% QoQ / +257% YoY, signing a $4B Indiana HBM production hub MOU on Aug 27, and benefiting directly from Nvidia's $267B memory spend commitment through 2030. Listed on NASDAQ in July 2026, the ADR remains structurally under-owned by US institutions, creating a supply/demand setup on top of fundamental undervaluation — with the September 16 Fed decision as the next binary macro risk (a hold would relieve rate pressure on high-multiple semis).
ideas.catalyst: September 16 Fed decision (hold = multiple expansion tailwind); HBM4 mass production ramp H2 2026; next SKHY earnings cycle Oct/Nov 2026
ideas.edge: Consensus 12-month analyst PT $247.31 vs. ~$177 current price = ~40% upside gap; 14/14 analysts rated Strong Buy; 0 Sell ratings; record Q2 revenue +257% YoY; $49.7B net cash backstops $28.6B buyback; IPO'd July 2026 = institutional under-ownership
ideas.bull_case: HBM4 dominance, Nvidia-linked demand, and a $28.6B buyback create a powerful fundamental floor; any dovish Fed surprise on Sept 16 could rapidly close the 40% gap to analyst targets as institutions build positions in the recently-listed ADR.
ideas.bear_case: A Fed hike on Sept 16 compresses high-multiple semi valuations broadly; memory cycles can reverse sharply on demand softening; as a newly-listed ADR, price discovery is still immature and liquidity can be thin on downside moves.
